_doc: P10 lead fixtures (contract §0.2 step 5, §3.4, §5.3, §5.4; lead-owned, frozen). Generated by the P10 lead's gen-fixtures.cjs; every ts is
computed from a local day and time in America/New_York (EST, UTC-5, on every day of the window). Invented names only.
channels[i].pages[j].response = conversations.history (CH shape, newest first) for the 8-day final window [2026-11-03, 2026-11-10]
read with oldest = the window's first local midnight; C0LEADNON1 has two pages (has_more + next_cursor). Every Zapier / app post carries
P10_PHI_SENTINELS in text, blocks, attachments, files, username, bot_profile, metadata and reactions; a human post in user_profile;
the unlinked private channel's NAME is a sentinel in channelSlug's form. channels[i].expect.shapes = readHistoryShapes' exact output for
the page messages in page order (exclusions = the DD bot's ids, USLACKBOT always); expect.days = tallyShapes over the window, zero days
included (C13: counted = bot, not a reply, not hidden, not excluded, subtype none or bot_message; skipped = not bot, not a reply, not
hidden, subtype none). memberPages = users.conversations (UC shape, two pages). fbList / markers / mapRows: the run's typed list, P7a's
markers for it and leadMapRows' rows (channel id order); listedNotMember / toClassify likewise; notMember as a set (listed here by taskId, i). neverRead: no
conversations.history call may name these (not a member, kind other, not a lead marker).
